property_summary: For all callers, only the direct caller equal to the current owner (msg.sender == owner) can successfully change owner via setOwner; the mutant using tx.origin allows a call routed through an intermediate contract to succeed when tx.origin == owner even if msg.sender != owner, so the mutant can change owner for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the require check require(msg.sender == owner); with require(tx.origin == owner); changing the authorization check to use tx.origin.
